nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf(address => uint) storing YIELD token balances in YIELDToken.
Public mapping allowance(owner => spender => uint) used by transferFrom/approve.
Fixed totalSupply = 140736000000000000000000000 of YIELD tokens.
Private owner address set in constructor, gates delegate() and list().
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used for liquidity operations.
Computed Uniswap pair address (wETH/YIELD) cached in constructor.
transfer(address,uint) payable that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
transferFrom with payable and checkLimits modifier; mutates allowance and balanceOf.
approve(address,uint) payable that writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Owner-only function performing delegatecall on an arbitrary address with arbitrary bytes.
Owner-only function setting balances and calling Uniswap addLiquidityETH, then airdropping tokens.
Modifier restricting transferFrom senders/recipients using owner, uniPair, tx.origin and msg.sender.
Constructor setting owner, computing uniPair, and granting infinite allowances.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash.
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for ownership and allowance checks.
tx.origin - origin-controlled address used inside checkLimits.
block.timestamp - miner-influenced value used as Uniswap deadline.
Low-level delegatecall to attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
External payable call to IUniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
Unchecked -= on allowance and balanceOf under Solidity 0.7 (no SafeMath in YIELDToken).
Unchecked arithmetic totalSupply * 6 / 100 and balance assignments in list().
Parameter _to of transfer().
Parameter _value of transfer/transferFrom/approve.
Parameter _from of transferFrom().
Parameter a (target address) of delegate().
Parameter b (calldata bytes) of delegate().
Parameter _numList used as token amount for liquidity in list().
Parameter _tos array of airdrop recipients in list().
Parameter _amounts array of airdrop amounts in list().
Parameter _spender of approve().
Parameter _from of checkLimits modifier.
Parameter _to of checkLimits modifier.
Loop counter i in list() airdrop loop.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates its logic to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
_to parameter flows into transferFrom recipient.
_value parameter flows into transferFrom amount.
_from parameter flows into transferFrom sender.
balanceOf mapping is read and written inside transferFrom.
allowance mapping is decremented inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared to _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
checkLimits modifier guards transferFrom execution.
msg.sender is compared to owner in the checkLimits modifier.
tx.origin is used as an authentication bypass in checkLimits.
owner state variable is compared against _from/_to in checkLimits.
uniPair state variable is used as an allowed _from in checkLimits.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using caller identity.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
approve mutates the allowance mapping.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
owner state variable is the gate condition for delegate().
target address parameter a flows into the delegatecall.
calldata bytes b flows into the delegatecall.
delegate() performs delegatecall to an owner-supplied address with owner-supplied data, allowing arbitrary code execution in the token context.
list requires msg.sender == owner and uses msg.sender as recipient.
owner state variable is the gate condition for list().
totalSupply is used in the airdrop arithmetic balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply*6/100.
list() performs unchecked multiplication and division on totalSupply and assigns raw balances.
list() writes directly into the balanceOf mapping for many addresses.
_numList parameter becomes balanceOf[address(this)] and liquidity amount.
_tos array elements are used as recipient keys in the airdrop loop.
_amounts array elements are assigned as balances in the airdrop loop.
Loop counter i indexes _tos and _amounts inside list().
list() makes an external payable call to the Uniswap router before/while mutating balances with no reentrancy guard.
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the router deadline enabling timestamp dependence.
list() computes a deadline from block.timestamp.
uniRouter state variable is the external contract invoked for addLiquidityETH.
constructor sets owner.
constructor assigns msg.sender as owner.
constructor computes and stores uniPair.
constructor grants infinite allowances to the router and pair.
constructor reads uniRouter to set the allowance.
pairFor is invoked by the constructor to derive uniPair.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to exists only to supply the recipient of transferFrom.
Parameter _value exists only to supply the amount of transferFrom.
Parameter _from exists only to supply the sender of transferFrom.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target used solely inside delegate().
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata used solely inside delegate().
Parameter _numList is consumed only by list() for liquidity and balance assignment.
Parameter _tos is iterated only inside list()'s airdrop loop.
Parameter _amounts is iterated only inside list()'s airdrop loop.
Parameter _spender is used only as the allowance mapping key in approve().
Parameter _from is used only by the checkLimits modifier.
Parameter _to is used only by the checkLimits modifier.
Local loop counter i exists only inside list()'s airdrop loop.
